snippet.title: Mobius - Official Steam Launch Trailer | Gravity Puzzle-Platformer
snippet.description:
If space has no end, where is the exit? Ready to challenge gravity and manipulate unique mechanics inside a Mobius strip to reach the impossible?

The Steam store page for our gravity puzzle-platformer, Mobius, is now live! We will also be releasing a playable demo during the Steam Next Fest on June 15th. If you are interested, please add the game to your Wishlist!

(This demo features brand-new mechanics and levels, along with major optimizations to the previous build. We hope you enjoy the experience!)
Thank you so much for your support!
